label: D2 arriving at S1 late in the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state shown is S1 (in_state==1; 22901 of 22911 dev activations). It is silent at D1 and GO, after reaching S2, and for the whole first ~70 trials of an episode: activity begins around ep_trial 70 and rises steeply toward trial 99 (rate 1% at trials 70-79, 6% at 80-89, 13% at 90-99). This tracks the model value head falling as the episode runs out, so the recorded predicate uses value < 6 (dev P 0.79, R 0.86, F1 0.82, mass recall 0.95). The ep_trial version, D2 & S1 & ep_trial >= 85, does a bit worse (F1 0.76), and value < 6.5 gives about the same F1 with higher recall. Magnitude: rare arrivals at S1 (a2 -> S1) are about 45% of activations but about 75% of the mass, and the top windows are all a2->S1 rare transitions, so rare transitions drive it harder than common a1->S1 ones. Reward, stay, and the good state barely change it. All variables in the predicate are observed at D2 (value is the model own output).

issues: All factual claims checked out on the dev profile. Phase: D1 has 0 activations, GO has 0, D2 has 22911. State: 22901 of 22911 activations are at S1 and 10 at S2. ep_trial: nothing before trial 60 (4 activations in 60-69), then rates of 1.0%, 6.4% and 12.8% in the 70s, 80s and 90s. Value: about 99.9% of activations fall in the bins below 7.13. Rare transitions: common==0 accounts for 45% of activations and 74.5% of activation mass. Reward, next_stay and chose_good have lifts between 0.8x and 1.2x, so they barely matter.
Test score reproduced: P 0.794, R 0.860, F1 0.826, mass recall 0.949.

The test misses hold only 5.1% of activation mass. They are weak activations, many of them rare a2->S1 arrivals with value just above the threshold. The false positives are D2 S1 steps near the value boundary. Neither group is a systematic class beyond the soft value threshold.

Alternatives did not do meaningfully better. A rare-dependent value threshold (value<5.5, or value<6.5 when rare) reached dev F1 0.827 against 0.822. Adding prev_reward==1 raised precision to 0.94 but cut recall to 0.65 (F1 0.77). Conditioning on good hurt badly (F1 0.69). ep_trial>=85 scores 0.763, consistent with the claim.

Small caveat: value is the model's own value-head output at the same D2 step, so the predicate is partly read out of the model's internal state. Using it is still allowed as an observed variable. The magnitude being larger after rare a2->S1 transitions is correctly presented as a modulation, not part of the predicate.
